text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I am Biwa Hayahide. We will be together 
for a long time. Let us get to know each 
other as time goes on.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My dream is the completion of the "Winning 
Formula." Proving the theory—I'll need you 
to help me with that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then. I have a theory I'd like to test 
right away. Are you ready, Trainer-kun?

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
